functions.name: BspLeafMaterialSelectionAndSubdivision
functions.summary: Recursive collision-material selection for a vertex region. Walks a singly linked list of vertices (head encoded in float argument a2, next pointer at byte offset 28) to count nodes. With fewer than 3 nodes the region is degenerate and classified with flag -1 or -2, the output pointer is reserved in an arena and spatial hash keys are generated per node. Otherwise a sampling stride derived from the node count selects material indices across 14 material types, sub_44A2D0 scores each candidate, and the lowest-coverage material wins. The chosen material is written as a classification word at this+8 (0 for indices <= 7, 1 otherwise) and a dispatch index word at this+10 (14 - index when extended, else the index), dispatch hooks are invoked on both, two float slots are reserved in the output arena pointed to by this+12, the coverage coordinates are stored, and the function recurses twice on the two child half-regions, returning 0 on success and -1 on recursion failure.

Initialize the vertex list walk: v5 takes the list head (float argument a2 re-read as a pointer) and the node counter v6 starts at 0.
If the list head a2 is null the list is empty and control jumps to the degenerate output path.
Walk the singly linked list via the next pointer at byte offset 28 until the null terminator, counting the nodes into v6.
If the node count is below 3, classify the region as degenerate: flag -1 written as a word at field this+8 when there is exactly 1 node, -2 when there are exactly 2.

Degenerate path: dispatch the classification byte from field this+8, write -1 as the dispatch index word at field this+10, reserve the output pointer from the arena record (base v3[9] plus 92 times slot counter v3[7]) into field this+12, and advance the arena slot counter.
Degenerate path: if the list head is non-null, iterate the node list again and call SpatialHashKeyGeneration for every node placed in the reserved output area.

For a non-degenerate region choose the material sampling stride v11 from the node count: 15 for at most 10 nodes, 6 for at most 100 nodes, otherwise 3; the loop step is 14 divided by v11, clamped to at least 1.
Sample material indices starting at (count modulo step) and advancing by step while below 14 material types.
CollisionMaterialLookup(i, out-values) resolves material data for the sampled index i.
sub_44A2D0 computes the coverage score for the current candidate material against the vertex list.
Track the best (lowest) coverage score: keep the best material index v20 initialized to -1 and the best score v21 initialized to the largest float.
Resolve the winning material with CollisionMaterialLookup and run a final sub_44A2D0 scoring pass with the persist flag for the selected material.
Write the material classification word at field this+8: 1 for a winning index above 7, 0 otherwise.
Write the dispatch material index word at field this+10: 14 minus the index for extended materials (index above 7), else the raw index.
ConditionalDispatch_6bd0 invoked with argument 1 on the classification byte (field this+8) and on the dispatch index byte (field this+10).
Reserve two float slots in the output arena: field this+12 becomes the arena base v3[12] plus 16 times the slot counter v3[10], and the slot counter advances by 2.
Store the coverage coordinate from v22[1] into the first output slot at buffer offset 0.
Store the coverage extent from v22[2] into the output buffer at byte offset 4.
Recurse into the first child half-region with sub_44A4B0(v22[0], arena); a non-zero result makes the function return -1.
Store the recursion result coordinates v22[4] into the output buffer at byte offset 16 and v22[5] at byte offset 20.
Recurse into the second child half-region with sub_44A4B0(v22[3], arena); the final return is 0 on success and -1 on recursion failure.
Return 0 on the degenerate path and either 0 or -1 (propagating a failed recursion) on the normal path.
